name: Time Capsule Created — Summary, Timeline & Schema Hook
description: Verifies that Time Capsule creation generates 1–200 word Archivist summaries, builds the chronological Historian timeline (R-PBT-3), and bundles Float32Array embeddings with forward-compatible capsuleVersion schema validation.

actions.prompt: Verify that Time Capsule creation: (1) generates 1–200 word extractive summaries for each document via the Archivist, (2) reconstructs chronological TimelineEntryRecords sorted ascending by resolvedDate (R-PBT-3) via the Historian, and (3) serialises/deserialises Float32Array vectors with capsuleVersion validation. Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/capsule.test.ts tests/unit/historian.test.ts`.
